description: make train's recipe - every stage's settings and seeds: the G2P network (nn/g2p.py) and its heteronym models (nn/context.py), the teacher (nn/trainmulti.py --recipe), and the distilled student with its evaluation and gate (nn/distill.py, nn/panel.py)

g2p.description: The G2P network (nn/g2p.py): the AR encoder-decoder trained on every dictionary word, frequency-weighted, with teacher-labeled unknown words, in four stages (base, two polishes over the most frequent words, then the readers' pronunciations of the relabeled words - focus), exported at 6 bits

context.description: The heteronym models (nn/contextlabels.py, nn/context.py): the context labels (the readers' aligned readings; part-of-speech tags over the Project Gutenberg books texts - pinned texts, pins (nn/books.py), fetched to books - where the tag mapping agrees with the audio; the hand-written seeds of data/nn/context-labels.json; and unlabeled transfer windows of the ambiguous words in the books, up to maxTransfer a word), the G2P's reading stage from the g2p recipe's last stage (the reading vectors, the ambiguity head, and the decoder), the context network (distilled from teachers - that many networks of their own seeds - toward their mean probabilities on its examples and the transfer windows, for steadiness), the export to lib/models/g2pModel.js, and the gates - the held-out aligned accuracy over the gate's words (less the S/Z-only pairs), and make train's comparison with the committed module (identical, else within these tolerances)

teacher.description: The teacher (nn/trainmulti.py --recipe teacher.a, then teacher.b): stage A on the readers (the 30,000-step schedule, stopped at 15,000), then stage B from A's weights with the emotional speech and the adversarial critic, 10,000 steps of the warmup-stable-decay schedule (constant, then the last 25% cooled down by 1 - sqrt - picovox_train/optim.py) - B's best validation checkpoint (validated every 1,000 steps through the cooldown, from step 7,500) is the teacher; A, whose last checkpoint B starts from, validates every 5,000; the keys are nn/trainmulti.py's flags, defaults every training setting's default

distill.description: Knowledge distillation of the teacher (nn/distill.py) - its distillation set (the targets: the training utterances, and the sentences of the Project Gutenberg books texts - pinned texts, pins (nn/books.py), fetched to books), the student's training (Muon for the hidden matrices with the warmup-stable-decay schedule - constant, then the last 25% cooled down by 1 - sqrt; picovox_train/optim.py), the student ladder, the polish fine-tune, the evaluation (nn/panel.py), and the tolerance (fixed before any student is measured)

tolerance.description: The smallest student whose mean UTMOS is within mos of the basis's (nn.distill pick --against: the teacher, or make train's baseline - the shipped lib/models/voiceModel.js, evaluated as packaged), whose Whisper WER is at most wer points worse, and whose speaker similarity to the teacher is at least similarity - the per-speaker cosine of the mean ECAPA embedding of the student's panel renderings with the mean of the teacher's renderings of the same texts, averaged over the six speakers

samples.description: The listening samples (tools/trainsamples.js): each training stage's final model - teacher A, teacher B, the student, and its polish - and the shipped app model (lib/models/voiceModel.js, before make train replaces it) as a reference, each speaking the texts in the speakers' voices as the app speaks them (static/audiobook/worker.js), scored with UTMOS on the CPU, in $(TRAIN_DIR)/samples/ (index.json lists them) for the training dashboard's Listen tab

texts.label: Moby-Dick's opening
texts.text: Call me Ishmael. Some years ago, never mind how long precisely, having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world.

texts.label: Dialogue
texts.text: "Wait! Did you hear that?" she whispered. "Only the wind," he said, laughing. "Go back to sleep."

texts.label: Heteronyms
texts.text: They read the lead story about how lives could be saved, and she will read it to the crowd before she leads them out.

style.description: The style network (picovox_train/style.py): a quotation's style - neutral, angry, shouting, or fearful - from its words and the narration around it, trained on a teacher's labels (data/nn/style-labels.json) of a sample of the pinned books' quotations (the context labels' books), each style's threshold for the validation precision "precision"; the hand-labeled quotations (data/nn/style-test.json) are its test
